title: Specification-Aware Distribution Shaping for Robotics Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.17969v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robotics foundation models have demonstrated strong capabilities in executing natural language instructions across diverse tasks and environments. However, they remain largely data-driven and lack formal guarantees on constraint satisfaction during deployment. In practice, robots often need to comply with operational constraints involving rich spatio-temporal requirements such as time-bounded goal visits, sequential objectives, and persistent safety conditions. In this work, we propose a specification-aware action distribution optimization framework that enforces a broad class of Signal Temporal Logic (STL) constraints during execution of a pretrained robotics foundation model without modifying its parameters. At each decision step, the method computes a minimally modified action distribution that satisfies a hard STL feasibility constraint by reasoning over the remaining horizon using forward dynamics propagation. We validate

translated_title: 面向机器人基础模型的规约感知分布整形
translated_abstract: 机器人基础模型在多样化任务和环境中执行自然语言指令方面已展现出强大的能力。然而，它们在很大程度上仍是数据驱动的，在部署过程中缺乏对约束满足的形式化保证。在实践中，机器人通常需要遵守涉及丰富时空需求的操作约束，例如有时间限制的目标访问、顺序目标以及持续性安全条件。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种规约感知的动作分布优化框架，该框架能够在预训练机器人基础模型的执行过程中强制满足一大类信号时序逻辑（STL）约束，而无需修改模型参数。在每个决策步骤中，该方法通过利用前向动力学传播对剩余时间范围进行推理，计算出满足硬STL可行性约束的最小修改动作分布。我们验证了……
tldr: 提出一种规约感知的动作分布优化框架，无需修改预训练机器人基础模型的参数，即可在其执行过程中强制满足信号时序逻辑（STL）约束。
en_tdlr: A specification-aware action distribution optimization framework that enforces Signal Temporal Logic (STL) constraints during the execution of pretrained robotics foundation models without modifying their parameters.
